uid="$(docker image inspect create-videobot:local-poll -f '{{.Config.User}}')"

docker image tag create-videobot:native-sticker-c8c50d4 create-videobot:local-poll

 echo STK_NATIVE_RECREATE_FAILED
 docker image tag create-videobot:poll-rollback create-videobot:local-poll
 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

 echo STK_NATIVE_RUNTIME_NOT_READY

 docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

import pg from 'pg';import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';

 password:readFileSync(e.VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_FILE,'utf8').trim(),max:1});

 const r=await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('videobot_sticker_paid_photo_sales','videobot_sticker_paid_photo_delivery')");
 if(r.rows[0]?.n!==2)throw Error('STK_NATIVE_DB_MIGRATION_NOT_PRESENT');
 process.stdout.write('STK_NATIVE_MIGRATION_015=PASS\n');
